definition: A **workman** is any person employed in an industry to do manual, unskilled, skilled, technical, operational, clerical, or supervisory work for hire or reward — but **excludes** persons in managerial/administrative capacity and those earning above the statutory wage ceiling (as notified). Correct classification decides access to ID Act/IRC protections, reinstatement remedies, and union membership issues.

statutoryReferences.note: Compare supervisory vs managerial tests in case law

cases.name: H.R. Adyanthaya v. Sandoz (India) Ltd.
cases.proposition: Discusses who is workman — functions and dominant nature of duties matter more than designation alone.

examChecklist.text: Consequences of being/not being a workman (dispute rights, protection on retrenchment)
